thesis: The primary conversion mechanism on this site is the coverage check, which acts as a gate before any plan or pricing information is shown. This forces users to commit to a qualification step without understanding the product or cost, and the homepage compounds the problem by presenting seven competing CTAs, diluting focus and delaying the path to conversion. The most valuable fix is to make coverage optional and surface plans and pricing upfront, reducing friction and building trust earlier in the journey.

findings.summary: No pricing is shown until the visitor completes the coverage/qualification form, so cost is discovered late in the journey.
findings.problem: No pricing is shown until the visitor completes the coverage/qualification form, so cost is discovered late in the journey.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Plans and Pricing; cta: See Plans; notes: Display starting prices or price range before qualification form.

findings.title: Value proposition lacks specifics
findings.summary: The hero headline promises reliability anywhere but fails to state what is sold or why it is better, leaving visitors without concrete reasons to convert.
